commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+7' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
90+6' A fine pass finds Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Antonio Sivera reacts superbly to deny him.
90+3' Ander Guevara (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+3' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ander Guevara (Alaves). Real Madrid have a free kick.
90+1' Having seen unsporting behavior, Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is the recipient.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Vinicius Junior will be replaced by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid).
89' Substitution. Yusi (Alaves) has come on for Victor Parada.
87' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
87' Referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
87' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ander Guevara (Alaves) replacing Denis Suarez.
83' Rodrygo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
81' The referee awards a corner and Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
81' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
80' The referee has issued a yellow card to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).

80' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Alaves earn a free kick.
80' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid). Victor Garcia saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
78' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Victor Valdepenas is replaced by Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid).
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) coming on for Arda Guler.

76' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Vinicius Junior, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Rodrygo (Real Madrid), who beats Antonio Sivera with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
76' What a chance to score from the free kick by Rodrygo (Real Madrid). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
75' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
75' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) trips an opposition player and Victor Garcia signals a foul. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

73' A clever short pass gives Antonio Blanco (Alaves) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
73' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
69' The Alaves players joy may have been justified, because referee Victor Garcia is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
68' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Carlos Vicente (Alaves) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
68' 1 - 1 What a beauty! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) makes contact with a cross on the edge of the box and finishes clinically with a shot inside the right post.
67' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Pablo Ibanez and he is replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
67' Substitution. Carles Alena (Alaves) on for Abderrahmane Rebbach.
67' Here is a change. Calebe is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
66' Victor Garcia blows the whistle, Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is penalised for a foul.
62' The attendance is 19290.
61' Lucas Boye (Alaves) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
58' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
58' Alaves spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
53' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

53' Antonio Sivera stretches to his left and makes a brilliant save! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper inside the right post. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
53' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Antonio Sivera.
51' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
51' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. Now Real Madrid have a corner.
50' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

49' Decent spell from Real Madrid here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

48' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Victor Garcia has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
45+2' It seemed like Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Alaves will take a free kick near the side line.
45+1' Calebe (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

45+1' Jonny Otto (Alaves) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' It seemed like Calebe (Alaves) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
44' Dangerous play by Raul Asencio (Real Madrid). Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Alaves.
43' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
40' Calebe (Alaves) prepares to take a corner kick.

39' Calebe (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
36' It seemed like Denis Suarez (Alaves) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
36' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. Alaves are awarded a free kick.
35' Real Madrid hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

31' Victor Parada (Alaves) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
31' Alaves quickly take the free kick with a short pass.

31' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and signals a foul after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Alaves, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
30' Good work from Alaves as they win a corner.
29' Alaves are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. Alaves get a corner.
28' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Victor Garcia due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) and his team.
28' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.

27' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.

24' 0 - 1 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top right corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
22' Alaves are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
18' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Calebe (Alaves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
17' Alaves are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.

11' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
11' Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
8' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
7' It seemed like Rodrygo (Real Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
6' Victor Parada (Alaves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
6' Victor Parada (Alaves) brings an opponent down and Victor Garcia interrupts the game. A free kick to Real Madrid.
5' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.

4' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
3' Some patient build-up play from Real Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
